description: Create, start, stop, restart, modify or terminate ECS instances.

parameters.name: alicloud_access_key
parameters.description: Alibaba Cloud access key. If not set then the value of environment variable ALICLOUD_ACCESS_KEY, ALICLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID is used instead.

parameters.name: alicloud_assume_role
parameters.description: If provided with a role ARN, Ansible attempts to assume this role using the supplied credentials. The nested assume_role block supports alicloud_assume_role_arn, alicloud_assume_role_session_name, alicloud_assume_role_session_expiration and alicloud_assume_role_policy.

parameters.name: alicloud_assume_role_arn
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud role_arn. The ARN of the role to assume. If ARN is set to an empty string, it does not perform role switching. It supports environment variable ALICLOUD_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN. Ansible executes with provided credentials.

parameters.name: alicloud_assume_role_session_expiration
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud session_expiration. The time after which the established session for assuming role expires. Valid value range 900-3600 seconds. Default to 3600 (in this case Alicloud use own default value). It supports environment variable ALICLOUD_ASSUME_ROLE_SESSION_EXPIRATION.

parameters.name: alicloud_assume_role_session_name
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud session_name. The session name to use when assuming the role. If omitted, ‘ansible’ is passed to the AssumeRole call as session name. It supports environment variable ALICLOUD_ASSUME_ROLE_SESSION_NAME.

parameters.name: alicloud_region
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud region to use. If not specified then the value of environment variable ALICLOUD_REGION, ALICLOUD_REGION_ID is used instead.

parameters.name: alicloud_secret_key
parameters.description: Alibaba Cloud secret key. If not set then the value of environment variable ALICLOUD_SECRET_KEY, ALICLOUD_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY is used instead.

parameters.name: alicloud_security_token
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud security token. If not specified then the value of environment variable ALICLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN is used instead.

parameters.name: allocate_public_ip
parameters.description: Whether allocate a public IP for the new instance. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: auto_renew
parameters.description: Whether automate renew the charge of the instance. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: auto_renew_period
parameters.description: The duration of the automatic renew the charge of the instance. Required when auto_renew=true. Choices: 1 2 3 6 12

parameters.name: availability_zone
parameters.description: Aliyun availability zone ID in which to launch the instance. If it is not specified, it is allocated by system automatically.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of the new instance. An integer value which indicates how many instances that match count_tag should be running. Instances are either created or terminated based on this value. Default: 1

parameters.name: count_tag
parameters.description: count determines how many instances based on a specific tag criteria should be present. This can be expressed in multiple ways and is shown in the EXAMPLES section. The specified count_tag must already exist or be passed in as the tags option. If it is not specified, it is replaced by instance_name.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of ECS instance, which is a string of 2 to 256 characters. It cannot begin with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Specifies whether to send a dry-run request. If dry_run=true, Only a dry-run request is sent and no instance is created. The system checks whether the required parameters are set, and validates the request format, service permissions, and available ECS instances. If the validation fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the validation succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned. If dry_run=false, a request is sent. If the validation succeeds, the instance is created. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: ecs_role_name
parameters.description: The RAM Role Name attached on a ECS instance for API operations. You can retrieve this from the ‘Access Control’ section of the Alibaba Cloud console. If you are running Ansible from an ECS instance with RAM Instance using RAM Role, Ansible just accesses the metadata http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/<ecs_role_name> to obtain the STS credential. This is a preferred approach over any other when running in ECS as you can avoid hard coding credentials. Instead these are leased on-the-fly by Ansible which reduces the chance of leakage.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Whether the current operation needs to be execute forcibly. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: host_name
parameters.description: Instance host name. Ordered hostname is not supported.

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Image ID used to launch instances. Required when state=present and creating new ECS instances.

parameters.name: include_data_disks
parameters.description: Whether to change instance disks charge type when changing instance charge type. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: instance_charge_type
parameters.description: The charge type of the instance. Choices: "PrePaid" "PostPaid" ← (default)

parameters.name: instance_ids
parameters.description: A list of instance IDs. It is required when need to operate existing instances. If it is specified, count is ignored.

parameters.name: instance_name
parameters.description: The name of ECS instance, which is a string of 2 to 128 Chinese or English characters. It must begin with an uppercase/lowercase letter or a Chinese character and can contain numerals, ., _ or -. It cannot begin with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: instance_type
parameters.description: Instance type used to launch instances. Required when state=present and creating new ECS instances.

parameters.name: internet_charge_type
parameters.description: Internet charge type of ECS instance. Choices: "PayByBandwidth" ← (default) "PayByTraffic"

parameters.name: key_name
parameters.description: The name of key pair which is used to access ECS instance in SSH.

parameters.name: max_bandwidth_in
parameters.description: Maximum incoming bandwidth from the public network, measured in Mbps (Megabits per second). Default: 200

parameters.name: max_bandwidth_out
parameters.description: Maximum outgoing bandwidth to the public network, measured in Mbps (Megabits per second). Required when allocate_public_ip=true. Ignored when allocate_public_ip=false. Default: 0

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password to login instance. After rebooting instances, modified password is effective.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The charge duration of the instance, in months. Required when instance_charge_type=PrePaid. The valid value are [1-9, 12, 24, 36]. Default: 1

parameters.name: period_unit
parameters.description: The duration unit that you are buying the resource. It is valid when instance_charge_type=PrePaid. Choices: "Month" ← (default) "Week"

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: This is the Alicloud profile name as set in the shared credentials file. It can also be sourced from the ALICLOUD_PROFILE environment variable.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: Delete any tags not specified in the task that are on the instance. If true, it means you have to specify all the desired tags on each task affecting an instance. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: ram_role_name
parameters.description: The name of the instance RAM role.

parameters.name: security_groups
parameters.description: A list of security group IDs.

parameters.name: shared_credentials_file
parameters.description: This is the path to the shared credentials file. It can also be sourced from the ALICLOUD_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE environment variable. If this is not set and a profile is specified, ~/.aliyun/config.json is used.

parameters.name: spot_price_limit
parameters.description: The maximum hourly price for the preemptible instance. This parameter supports a maximum of three decimal places and takes effect when the SpotStrategy parameter is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

parameters.name: spot_strategy
parameters.description: The bidding mode of the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter is valid when instance_charge_type=PostPaid. Choices: "NoSpot" ← (default) "SpotWithPriceLimit" "SpotAsPriceGo"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the instance after operating. Choices: "present" ← (default) "running" "stopped" "restarted" "absent"

parameters.name: system_disk_category
parameters.description: Category of the system disk. Choices: "cloud_efficiency" ← (default) "cloud_ssd"

parameters.name: system_disk_description
parameters.description: Description of the system disk.

parameters.name: system_disk_name
parameters.description: Name of the system disk.

parameters.name: system_disk_size
parameters.description: Size of the system disk, in GB. The valid values are 40~500. Default: 40

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A hash/dictionaries of instance tags, to add to the new instance or for starting/stopping instance by tag. {"key":"value"}.

parameters.name: unique_suffix
parameters.description: Specifies whether to add sequential suffixes to the host_name. The sequential suffix ranges from 001 to 999. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: user_data
parameters.description: User-defined data to customize the startup behaviors of an ECS instance and to pass data into an ECS instance. It only takes effect when launching the new ECS instances.

parameters.name: vswitch_id
parameters.description: The subnet ID in which to launch the instances (VPC).

examples:
# basic provisioning example vpc network
- name: Basic provisioning example
  hosts: localhost
  vars:
    alicloud_access_key: <your-alicloud-access-key-id>
    alicloud_secret_key: <your-alicloud-access-secret-key>
    alicloud_region: cn-beijing
    image: ubuntu1404_64_40G_cloudinit_20160727.raw
    instance_type: ecs.n4.small
    vswitch_id: vsw-abcd1234
    assign_public_ip: true
    max_bandwidth_out: 10
    host_name: myhost
    password: mypassword
    system_disk_category: cloud_efficiency
    system_disk_size: 100
    internet_charge_type: PayByBandwidth
    security_groups: ["sg-f2rwnfh23r"]

    instance_ids: ["i-abcd12346", "i-abcd12345"]
    force: true

  tasks:
    - name: Launch ECS instance in VPC network
      community.general.ali_instance:
        alicloud_access_key: '{{ alicloud_access_key }}'
        alicloud_secret_key: '{{ alicloud_secret_key }}'
        alicloud_region: '{{ alicloud_region }}'
        image: '{{ image }}'
        system_disk_category: '{{ system_disk_category }}'
        system_disk_size: '{{ system_disk_size }}'
        instance_type: '{{ instance_type }}'
        vswitch_id: '{{ vswitch_id }}'
        assign_public_ip: '{{ assign_public_ip }}'
        internet_charge_type: '{{ internet_charge_type }}'
        max_bandwidth_out: '{{ max_bandwidth_out }}'
        tags:
          Name: created_one
        host_name: '{{ host_name }}'
        password: '{{ password }}'

    - name: With count and count_tag to create a number of instances
      community.general.ali_instance:
        alicloud_access_key: '{{ alicloud_access_key }}'
        alicloud_secret_key: '{{ alicloud_secret_key }}'
        alicloud_region: '{{ alicloud_region }}'
        image: '{{ image }}'
        system_disk_category: '{{ system_disk_category }}'
        system_disk_size: '{{ system_disk_size }}'
        instance_type: '{{ instance_type }}'
        assign_public_ip: '{{ assign_public_ip }}'
        security_groups: '{{ security_groups }}'
        internet_charge_type: '{{ internet_charge_type }}'
        max_bandwidth_out: '{{ max_bandwidth_out }}'
        tags:
          Name: created_one
          Version: 0.1
        count: 2
        count_tag:
          Name: created_one
        host_name: '{{ host_name }}'
        password: '{{ password }}'

    - name: Start instance
      community.general.ali_instance:
        alicloud_access_key: '{{ alicloud_access_key }}'
        alicloud_secret_key: '{{ alicloud_secret_key }}'
        alicloud_region: '{{ alicloud_region }}'
        instance_ids: '{{ instance_ids }}'
        state: 'running'

    - name: Reboot instance forcibly
      ecs:
        alicloud_access_key: '{{ alicloud_access_key }}'
        alicloud_secret_key: '{{ alicloud_secret_key }}'
        alicloud_region: '{{ alicloud_region }}'
        instance_ids: '{{ instance_ids }}'
        state: 'restarted'
        force: '{{ force }}'

    - name: Add instances to an security group
      ecs:
        alicloud_access_key: '{{ alicloud_access_key }}'
        alicloud_secret_key: '{{ alicloud_secret_key }}'
        alicloud_region: '{{ alicloud_region }}'
        instance_ids: '{{ instance_ids }}'
        security_groups: '{{ security_groups }}'
